finding: cross-shift rank-2 kernel: coset sees only the trivial phase (||P U_D S Q P||^2 = 1 at q=0, 0 otherwise)
significance: the rank-2 diagonal coset is EXACTLY flat (position-sector only); the cross-shift S does not mix sectors.  The Weil correction at rank-2 requires a NON-diagonal Sp4 element (the full Hecke operator mixing position and momentum) — the remaining M4d work.
